Name: Survival Valley
Author: war77
Description:
[center][size=7][b]🌲 SURVIVAL VALLEY 🌲[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Turn Stardew Valley into a living survival experience.[/i][/size]

Survival Valley adds hunger, thirst, body needs, temperature, hygiene,
nutrition, weight, swimming, wagons, exercise, item mastery and much more —
all designed to work alongside normal Stardew Valley gameplay.
[/center]

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🍖 HUNGER & CALORIES[/b][/size][/center]

Your farmer now needs to eat.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1787255360-498199021.png[/img]

Survival Valley introduces a persistent [b]Calorie Bar[/b] which gradually
depletes throughout the day.

Food restores calories based on its nutritional properties, while physical
activity causes your body to burn additional energy.

Your calorie consumption can be affected by:

[list]
[*]Normal activity[/*]
[*]Tool use[/*]
[*]Combat[/*]
[*]Fishing[/*]
[*]Swimming[/*]
[*]Pulling heavy loads[/*]
[*]Environmental conditions[/*]
[*]Other strenuous activities[/*]
[/list]
Running out of calories makes surviving and working around the valley much
more difficult.

Instead of eating simply because your energy bar is low, food becomes an
important resource that must be planned throughout the day.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]💧 THIRST & HYDRATION[/b][/size][/center]

Your farmer also needs water.

The [b]Thirst Bar[/b] gradually drains as time passes.

Hot weather, physical activity and other survival conditions can increase
your need for water.

Drinks restore hydration, and beverages can have different amounts of
usable liquid.

You can even drink from your [b]Watering Can[/b] in an emergency — although
untreated water isn't always the safest choice!

Seasonal conditions affect hydration requirements:

[b]Spring:[/b] increased thirst
[b]Summer:[/b] significantly increased thirst
[b]Fall:[/b] normal
[b]Winter:[/b] reduced thirst

Keeping hydrated becomes especially important while working during hot
summer days.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🚽 PEE & POO SYSTEM[/b][/size][/center]

What goes in eventually has to come out.

Survival Valley tracks two additional biological needs:

[b]Pee[/b]
and
[b]Poo[/b]

These gradually accumulate throughout the day based on your food and drink
consumption.

As the meters rise, your farmer begins experiencing increasingly noticeable
effects.

At high levels your farmer may:

[list]
[*]Begin sweating[/*]
[*]Become uncomfortable[/*]
[*]Use additional stamina during activities[/*]
[*]Perform the desperate "pee dance"[/*]
[/list]
And when things become critical...

[center][size=5][b]~~ IT'S PEE PEE POO POO TIME!! ~~[/b][/size][/center]

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🚽 TOILETS & RELIEF[/b][/size][/center]

Fortunately, the valley now has bathrooms.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1787255440-1823723241.png[/img]

Toilets can be found in a variety of useful locations including homes and
public buildings.

Using a toilet gradually empties your body's waste meters.

You can also craft your own toilet for your farm.

If no bathroom is available, Survival Valley provides an emergency
[b]Relief[/b] option.

Using the wilderness isn't exactly sanitary, however...

Doing so can leave your farmer [b]Stinky[/b].

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🚿 HYGIENE & SHOWERS[/b][/size][/center]

Survival Valley introduces hygiene mechanics.

If your farmer becomes Stinky, NPCs may react negatively.

Being Stinky can cause:

[list]
[*]Visible dirt and odor effects[/*]
[*]Unique NPC reactions[/*]
[*]Reduced friendship gains[/*]
[/list]
Take a shower to clean yourself.

Showers remove the Stinky condition and even restore a small amount of
hydration.

[b]Taking a shower restores 10% of your Water Bar.[/b]

Rain can also clean you while outdoors.

If you're desperate, jumping into water can help too!

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🤒 SICKNESS[/b][/size][/center]

Survival isn't always clean.

Drinking questionable water can make your farmer sick.

For example, drinking directly from your Watering Can has a chance of
causing illness.

Your Foraging skill helps reduce this risk.

Sickness can affect your body's normal needs until you're cured.

You can recover through methods such as:

[list]
[*]Using a toilet[/*]
[*]Taking appropriate medicine[/*]
[*]Resting until the condition passes[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center][size=5][b]💩 CONSTIPATION[/b][/size][/center]

Nutrition matters.

Eating too many foods without enough fiber can cause [b]Constipation[/b].

When constipated, bathroom activities become significantly slower.

Fiber-rich foods can help prevent the condition.

Laxatives and other remedies can also provide relief.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🥩 NUTRITION SYSTEM[/b][/size][/center]

Food is more than calories.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1787255428-1522033252.png[/img]

Survival Valley tracks nutritional properties which can produce special
effects.

[size=4][b]💪 Protein[/b][/size]

Protein contributes to physical strength.

Protein-rich foods can temporarily increase your combat effectiveness.

[size=4][b]🍬 Sugar[/b][/size]

Sugar provides a temporary burst of speed.

But what goes up must come down.

After the Sugar Rush ends, your farmer can experience a [b]Sugar Crash[/b].

[size=4][b]🌾 Fiber[/b][/size]

Fiber supports healthy digestion and helps prevent constipation.

Different foods therefore have different survival purposes beyond simply
restoring energy.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🌡️ TEMPERATURE SYSTEM[/b][/size][/center]

The valley now has temperature.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1787255453-86215966.png[/img]

Outdoor temperatures change according to:

[list]
[*]Season[/*]
[*]Time of day[/*]
[*]Weather[/*]
[*]Nearby heat sources[/*]
[*]Water exposure[/*]
[*]Clothing[/*]
[/list]
Summer days can become dangerously hot.

Winter nights can become brutally cold.

Typical seasonal temperatures can range from hot summer afternoons near
[b]100°F[/b] to winter conditions dropping below [b]0°F[/b].

Survival Valley also supports displaying temperature in:

[b]Fahrenheit[/b]
or
[b]Celsius[/b]

through the configuration menu.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🏠 INDOOR & OUTDOOR TEMPERATURE[/b][/size][/center]

Outdoor and indoor environments are treated differently.

When outside, the outdoor temperature gauge is displayed.

When indoors, an indoor temperature gauge takes its place.

Buildings provide protection from extreme weather, while nearby heat sources
can dramatically change your immediate temperature.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🔥 HEAT SOURCES[/b][/size][/center]

Fire produces real warmth.

Standing within approximately five tiles of an active heat source can raise
your local temperature by roughly:

[b]+20°F[/b]

Heat sources can include things such as:

[list]
[*]Campfires[/*]
[*]Forges[/*]
[*]Ovens[/*]
[*]Torches[/*]
[*]Other burning objects[/*]
[/list]
This can be extremely useful during winter.

But standing near a blazing forge during summer may not be such a good idea.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]👕 CLOTHING & TEMPERATURE[/b][/size][/center]

Your clothing now matters.

Clothing provides either [b]Warmth[/b] or [b]Cooling[/b] depending on what
would logically make sense for that item.

Examples include:

[b]T-Shirts[/b]
Provide a small cooling effect.

[b]Shorts[/b]
Help keep your farmer cooler.

[b]Long Pants[/b]
Provide mild warmth.

[b]Sweaters[/b]
Provide significantly more warmth.

[b]Scarves, Mittens & Gloves[/b]
Help protect against cold weather.

This means you may want different outfits for different seasons.

That winter sweater may save you in January...

...but wearing it during a 100°F summer afternoon probably isn't wise.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]💦 SWIMMING & BODY TEMPERATURE[/b][/size][/center]

Jumping into water immediately lowers your body temperature by approximately:

[b]20°F[/b]

After leaving the water, your temperature gradually returns to normal over
approximately [b]five real-world minutes[/b].

Swimming also consumes stamina.

[b]Approximately 1 stamina is consumed for every 2 tiles swum.[/b]

Swimming therefore becomes useful for cooling down during extreme heat, but
it isn't free exercise.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]⚖️ ITEM WEIGHT[/b][/size][/center]

Your inventory has weight.

Items display their approximate weight directly on their inventory icons.

Your total carried weight is tracked and displayed in the interface.

As your inventory becomes heavier:

[list]
[*]Movement becomes more difficult[/*]
[*]Stamina consumption increases[/*]
[*]Calories burn faster[/*]
[*]Hydration requirements increase[/*]
[/list]
Wet clothing can even temporarily add additional weight until it dries.

The result is an inventory system where deciding [i]what[/i] to carry can
matter just as much as how many inventory slots remain.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🛒 THE WAGON[/b][/size][/center]

Need to haul more than you can carry?

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1787255468-391717430.png[/img]

Build a wagon!

The wagon provides portable storage that can be physically pulled behind
your farmer.

You can:

[list]
[*][b]Pull[/b] the wagon[/*]
[*][b]Leave It Here[/b][/*]
[*][b]Open its Inventory[/b][/*]
[*][b]Sit[/b] on it and rest[/*]
[/list]
The wagon follows behind the farmer as you travel around the valley.

Its movement supports cardinal and diagonal directions.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🏋️ WAGON WEIGHT[/b][/size][/center]

A loaded wagon isn't free transportation.

The heavier your wagon becomes, the harder it is to pull.

Wagon weight affects:

[list]
[*]Movement[/*]
[*]Stamina consumption[/*]
[*]Physical exertion[/*]
[*]Sweating[/*]
[/list]
Very heavy wagons can cause your farmer to visibly sweat.

Pulling a wagon also consumes significantly more stamina than ordinary
walking.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🪑 SITTING ON THE WAGON[/b][/size][/center]

Park your wagon and choose:

[b]Sit[/b]

Your farmer jumps onto the front of the wagon and sits down.

While sitting, stamina regenerates similarly to resting in a chair.

Performing another interaction causes your farmer to hop back off and resume
normal activity.

Your wagon can therefore double as a portable resting spot during long
expeditions.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🎨 OLD & NEW WAGON STYLES[/b][/size][/center]

Survival Valley includes multiple wagon visual styles.

Use the configuration menu to choose between:

[b]New Wagon[/b]

The newer Survival Valley wagon with full directional and diagonal graphics.

[b]Old Wagon[/b]

The classic handcart-style wagon from earlier versions of the mod.

Choose whichever style fits your farm best.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🐟 FISH WEIGHT & EXERTION[/b][/size][/center]

Fishing is now physical work.

Larger and heavier fish require more effort to land.

The weight of your catch can increase the amount of:

[list]
[*]Stamina consumed[/*]
[*]Calories burned[/*]
[/list]
Large catches therefore become more demanding than tiny fish.

Fish can also visually scale according to their weight, making especially
large catches actually look larger.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]💪 MUSCLE & EXERCISE[/b][/size][/center]

Physical activity contributes to your farmer's physical development.

Build your Muscle progression to unlock access to exercise equipment.

Exercise equipment now unlocks at:

[b]50 Muscle[/b]

instead of the older 250 requirement.

Training gives players another way to develop their farmer outside of
traditional Stardew skills.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]⏰ CUSTOM TIME SCALE[/b][/size][/center]

Want longer days?

Or faster ones?

Survival Valley includes an integrated customizable game clock.

Using GMCM, you can configure how quickly Stardew Valley time passes compared
with real time.

For example:

[b]1 : 1[/b]
1 real minute = 1 in-game minute

[b]1 : 5[/b]
1 real minute = 5 in-game minutes

This allows Survival Valley to support everything from long, relaxed survival
days to faster traditional Stardew pacing.

[line]

[center][size=6][b]🏅 STARMASTERY[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]The more you use it, the better you become with it.[/i][/size][/center]

Survival Valley includes the complete [b]Starmastery[/b] item-progression
system.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1787255486-1164135605.png[/img]

Instead of only improving broad skills, Starmastery tracks your experience
with [b]individual items[/b].

Your Parsnip has its own mastery.

Your Axe has its own mastery.

Your Sword has its own mastery.

Your Fishing Rod has its own mastery.

Even resources such as Stone, Coal and Ore can become individually mastered.

[b]Maximum Mastery Level: 999[/b]

[line]

[center][size=5][b]📈 GAINING MASTERY XP[/b][/size][/center]

Mastery XP is earned through normal interactions with an item.

Depending on the item, this can include:

[list]
[*]Picking items up[/*]
[*]Using tools[/*]
[*]Harvesting resources[/*]
[*]Using weapons[/*]
[*]Catching fish[/*]
[*]Eating food[/*]
[*]Drinking beverages[/*]
[*]Using repair supplies[/*]
[*]Shipping items[/*]
[/list]
[b]IMPORTANT:[/b]

Your mastery level does [b]not[/b] make future mastery levels easier to earn.

Mastery XP progresses at its normal configured rate regardless of whether
the item is Level 1 or Level 900.

Players who intentionally want faster or slower progression can still use
the configurable [b]Mastery XP Multiplier[/b].

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🥕 CROP & PRODUCE MASTERY[/b][/size][/center]

Crops, vegetables, fruits, flowers and similar produce gain:

[b]+0.1g sale value per mastery level[/b]

Level 10 Parsnip:

[b]+1g per Parsnip[/b]

Level 100:

[b]+10g[/b]

Level 999:

[b]+99.9g mastery value[/b]

Each crop is mastered independently.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]⚔️ WEAPON MASTERY[/b][/size][/center]

Weapons gain:

[b]+0.1 Damage per mastery level[/b]

Level 10:

[b]+1 Damage[/b]

Level 100:

[b]+10 Damage[/b]

Level 999:

[b]+99.9 Damage[/b]

Your favorite weapon can therefore become increasingly powerful through
continued use.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🪓 HARVESTING TOOL MASTERY[/b][/size][/center]

Harvesting tools improve the resources associated with their job.

[b]Axe[/b]
+0.1 additional Wood per level.

[b]Pickaxe[/b]
+0.1 additional Stone per level.

[b]Hoe[/b]
+0.1 additional Clay per level.

[b]Scythe[/b]
+0.1 additional Fiber per level.

At Mastery Level 10, this becomes approximately:

[b]+1 additional resource[/b]

Fractional resource bonuses are handled over repeated harvesting so that
lower mastery levels still contribute over time.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🎣 FISHING ROD MASTERY[/b][/size][/center]

Fishing Rod mastery increases the weight of fish caught.

[b]+0.1 lb per mastery level[/b]

or the metric equivalent when using metric units.

Level 10:

[b]+1 lb/kg[/b]

Level 100:

[b]+10 lb/kg[/b]

Because heavier fish require more stamina and calories to catch, mastering
your Fishing Rod can create both bigger rewards and harder fights.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]💧 WATERING CAN MASTERY[/b][/size][/center]

Each Watering Can mastery level provides:

[b]+0.1% Water Efficiency[/b]

Level 10:

[b]1%[/b]

Level 100:

[b]10%[/b]

Level 500:

[b]50%[/b]

Level 999:

[b]99.9%[/b]

The cap deliberately prevents 100% efficiency.

Even the most legendary Watering Can in the valley will eventually need to
be refilled.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🍲 FOOD MASTERY[/b][/size][/center]

Cooked foods gain:

[b]+0.1% Calories and Energy/Stamina restored per mastery level[/b]

Level 10:

[b]+1%[/b]

Level 100:

[b]+10%[/b]

Level 999:

[b]+99.9%[/b]

Your farmer literally becomes better at making use of foods they have
mastered.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🥤 DRINK MASTERY[/b][/size][/center]

Drinks gain:

[b]+0.1% Hydration and Energy/Stamina per mastery level[/b]

This makes frequently used beverages increasingly effective without treating
them exactly like solid food.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🧰 REPAIR ITEM MASTERY[/b][/size][/center]

Repair supplies can also be mastered.

This includes items such as:

[list]
[*]Whetstones[/*]
[*]Sewing Kits[/*]
[*]Farming Repair Kits[/*]
[*]Fishing Rod Repair Kits[/*]
[*]Other compatible repair supplies[/*]
[/list]
Each mastery level saves:

[b]0.1 durability per repair[/b]

At Level 10:

[b]1 durability point saved per repair[/b]

Fractional savings carry forward between repairs.

Repair items will still consume at least [b]1 durability[/b], preventing
mastery from making a repair kit permanently indestructible.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🪨 RESOURCE & MISCELLANEOUS MASTERY[/b][/size][/center]

Sellable items that don't have their own specialized mastery benefit receive
a general value bonus.

Examples include:

[list]
[*]Stone[/*]
[*]Coal[/*]
[*]Ore[/*]
[*]Minerals[/*]
[*]Bars[/*]
[*]Resources[/*]
[*]Other miscellaneous sellable materials[/*]
[/list]
These items receive:

[b]+0.1g sale value per mastery level[/b]

Level 10:

[b]+1g per item[/b]

Level 100:

[b]+10g[/b]

Level 999:

[b]+99.9g mastery value[/b]

Items with their own specialized mastery effect do not also stack this
generic benefit.

[line]

[center][size=5][b]🏅 THE STARMASTERY PAGE[/b][/size][/center]

Open your inventory and select the [b]Medal[/b] tab to access your item
masteries.



The Starmastery interface lets you track your growing collection of mastered
items and see information such as:

[list]
[*]Current Mastery Level[/*]
[*]Current Mastery XP[/*]
[*]Progress toward the next level[/*]
[*]Item interactions[/*]
[*]Current item-specific mastery benefit[/*]
[/list]
Hover over an item to see exactly what its current mastery level provides.

Controller navigation is supported as well.

[line]

[center][size=6][b]⚙️ HIGHLY CONFIGURABLE[/b][/size][/center]

Survival Valley is designed to be customized.

Generic Mod Config Menu integration provides settings for many of the mod's
systems, allowing you to tune the survival experience to your preferred
difficulty and play style.

Configure the systems you want and build your own version of Survival Valley.

[line]

[center][size=6][b]🌲 LIVE IN THE VALLEY — DON'T JUST FARM IT 🌲[/b][/size]

Survival Valley transforms everyday Stardew Valley activities into connected
survival mechanics.

[b]Eat.
Drink.
Stay warm.
Stay clean.
Carry what you can.
Rest when you're tired.
Haul what you can't carry.
Master the tools and items you depend on.

And survive another day in the valley.[/b]
[/center]
